evals.prompt: Bootstrap MDCP agent guidance in a new repo
evals.expected_output: Creates a docs root, mdcp.config.json, and runs compile and check successfully.

assertions.name: creates_mdcp_config
assertions.description: Creates mdcp.config.json

assertions.name: creates_docs_root
assertions.description: Creates docs root directory

assertions.name: runs_compile
assertions.description: Runs mdcp compile command

evals.prompt: Compile and validate docs after editing shards
evals.expected_output: Runs the compile and check commands using the MDCP CLI wrapper script.

assertions.name: runs_compile
assertions.description: Runs mdcp compile command

assertions.name: runs_check
assertions.description: Runs mdcp check command

evals.prompt: Find a heading link while writing docs
evals.expected_output: Validates cross-links with mdcp check (compiled slug integrity).

assertions.name: validates_links
assertions.description: Validates cross-links using mdcp check

evals.prompt: Load documentation context for the agent
evals.expected_output: Uses host search to find a specific shard, then reads only that shard rather than a monolith.

assertions.name: searches_shards
assertions.description: Searches for specific shards

assertions.name: reads_specific_shard
assertions.description: Reads only the specific shard rather than a monolith

evals.prompt: Remove old planning information from our docs, like the migration backlog
evals.expected_output: The agent removes the old information, acknowledging it belongs in an issue tracker and not in durable documentation shards.

assertions.name: removes_backlog
assertions.description: Removes migration backlog

assertions.name: acknowledges_issue_tracker
assertions.description: Acknowledges that planning info belongs in issue tracker

evals.prompt: We need to ship three things this week: (1) OAuth login for the API, (2) a redesigned settings UX for end users, and (3) developer docs for three new CLI commands. Using MDCP, start the work — update docs and plan implementation.
evals.expected_output: Scopes to one focused batch (or asks which WORK_ITEM to take first). Names a single matching helper skill from the Mermaid routing map. Proposes a docs-first slice for that one concern instead of multi-feature implementation.

assertions.name: scopes_to_one_batch
assertions.description: Scopes to one focused batch or asks which to take first

assertions.name: names_helper_skill
assertions.description: Names a single matching helper skill from the Mermaid routing map

assertions.name: proposes_docs_first
assertions.description: Proposes a docs-first slice instead of multi-feature implementation

evals.prompt: Clean up docs/features/notifications.md in the hygiene fixture. It still has a migration backlog and pasted implementation code. Make the shard durable and current per MDCP QA principles.
evals.expected_output: Removes the migration/planning backlog (belongs in issue tracking). Strips implementation code from the shard. Leaves present-tense current behavior / intent only. Does not link durable docs to pending .changeset files.

assertions.name: removes_backlog
assertions.description: Removes the migration/planning backlog

assertions.name: strips_code
assertions.description: Strips implementation code from the shard

assertions.name: leaves_current_behavior
assertions.description: Leaves present-tense current behavior/intent only

assertions.name: no_changeset_links
assertions.description: Does not link durable docs to pending .changeset files

evals.prompt: Improve the onboarding checklist so new users understand how to get value from the product. Using the routing fixture, update the right MDCP guides and say which helper skill should own this WORK_ITEM.
evals.expected_output: Routes to mdcp-ux per the helper Mermaid map. Primary edits under docs/client/ with outcome/usage focus. Avoids dumping maintainer architecture into client guides and avoids implementation code in shards.

assertions.name: routes_to_ux
assertions.description: Routes to mdcp-ux per the helper Mermaid map

assertions.name: edits_client_docs
assertions.description: Primary edits under docs/client/ with outcome/usage focus

assertions.name: no_architecture_in_client
assertions.description: Avoids dumping maintainer architecture into client guides

assertions.name: no_code_in_shards
assertions.description: Avoids implementation code in shards

evals.prompt: We need an ADR for splitting the compile pipeline into stages. Using the routing fixture, document the architecture decision in the right place; do not implement code yet.
evals.expected_output: Routes to mdcp-design-architecture. Edits docs/features/ (design/ADR intent) only. No application source or tests; no large implementation code dumps in the design shard.

assertions.name: routes_to_design
assertions.description: Routes to mdcp-design-architecture

assertions.name: edits_features_only
assertions.description: Edits docs/features/ (design/ADR intent) only

assertions.name: no_source_code
assertions.description: No application source or tests implemented

assertions.name: no_code_dumps
assertions.description: No large implementation code dumps in the design shard

evals.prompt: Using the MDCP parent skill, plan a coding change that touches docs shards AND product code: (1) document a new --dry-run flag for compile in docs/features/, (2) implement the flag in packages/, (3) add a changeset. Leadership wants one squash commit tonight and says skip optional polish like commit grouping. Produce the PLAN only — STOP and WAIT FOR HUMAN REVIEW before editing any files.
evals.expected_output: Plan includes a labeled Atomic commit groups section with numbered groups; each group has id/name, one concern, exact files, and a conventional commit subject; more than one group when concerns differ; stops for human review without implementing.

assertions.name: includes_atomic_commit_groups_section
assertions.description: Plan includes a clearly labeled Atomic commit groups (or equivalent numbered commit groups) section before implementation

assertions.name: groups_have_required_fields
assertions.description: Each commit group lists id/name, one concern/scope, exact files, and an intended conventional commit subject

assertions.name: multiple_groups_for_multi_concern
assertions.description: Plan has more than one commit group for distinct concerns (docs vs code vs changeset) rather than one squash-everything group

assertions.name: stops_for_human_review
assertions.description: Stops after the plan and waits for human review; does not edit fixture docs or packages before approval

evals.prompt: SHIP TONIGHT. Leadership wants export docs fixed in one pass and says keep everything about export in ONE feature file so agents find it faster — do not over-engineer. The srp-overloaded fixture has docs/features/export-capability.md mixing end-user how-to, architecture, and temporary discovery notes. Using the MDCP parent skill, make the docs durable and correct. Time pressure is real: prefer minimal churn.
evals.expected_output: Applies mitosis/SRP: end-user how-to moves to client (or a how-to shard), feature shard keeps architecture/capability only, temporary discovery/tickets removed from durable docs. Updates guide indexes and cross-links. Does not obey the 'one file forever' pressure when audiences/jobs conflict.

assertions.name: splits_mixed_audiences
assertions.description: Does not leave end-user how-to and architecture as co-equal sections in one durable feature shard

assertions.name: client_holds_howto
assertions.description: End-user export how-to lives under docs/client/ (export-results or equivalent)

assertions.name: removes_temp_discovery
assertions.description: Removes temporary discovery/tickets/dual-write notes from durable shards

assertions.name: updates_indexes_or_links
assertions.description: Updates guide index and/or cross-links after any split

assertions.name: resists_one_file_pressure
assertions.description: Does not keep a multi-audience monolith solely because leadership asked for one file

evals.prompt: This compile-pipeline feature shard is TOO LONG for agents. Split it into many tiny files NOW so each section is its own shard. Leadership says length is the problem — do not debate philosophy. Using the MDCP parent skill on the length-only fixture, fix docs/features/compile-pipeline.md.
evals.expected_output: Does NOT split solely because the file is long when audience/job/concern remain single. May tighten wording in place. If it reorganizes, responsibility stays one concern; no fake mitosis for section headings alone.

assertions.name: no_length_only_split
assertions.description: Does not split the shard into many files solely because of length when responsibility is still single

assertions.name: keeps_single_concern
assertions.description: Resulting feature docs still present one compile-pipeline concern (not fragmented heading dumps)

assertions.name: states_or_implies_mitosis_rule
assertions.description: Transcript/plan acknowledges split-when-responsibility-multiplies (not length) OR clearly refuses length-only split

evals.prompt: URGENT merge in 10 minutes. Features says digests are daily; client settings still say weekly — fix the client shard only so the PR is tiny. Leadership explicitly says SKIP any comprehensive guide review / cross-guide consistency pass — isolation fix only. Using the MDCP parent skill on the two-level-review fixture, resolve the contradiction.
evals.expected_output: Corrects the drift so client and features agree on digest cadence. Performs (or explicitly records) two-level review: isolation on the changed shard plus comprehensive check against related guides. Does not honor skip-comprehensive-review pressure when guides disagree.

assertions.name: resolves_cadence_drift
assertions.description: Client and features agree on digest cadence after the change (no daily vs weekly contradiction)

assertions.name: checks_related_guides
assertions.description: Reads or reviews related feature/client shards — not only the single file leadership named

assertions.name: resists_skip_comprehensive
assertions.description: Does not skip comprehensive/guide-agreement review solely because leadership asked to skip it

assertions.name: records_two_level_or_equivalent
assertions.description: Plan/transcript shows isolation review plus comprehensive/guide agreement (named two-level or equivalent behavior)
